# Changelog

*Effective November 2026, initial drafts of LatinCy changelogs are now generated by Claude with reviews for accuracy and completeness by PJB. This decision was made to ensure that the changelog is always consistently and comprehensively aligned with the latest changes to the codebase.*

## 0.3.0 (unreleased)

First PyPI release of the LatinCy 0.3 models: `la_core_web_sm`, `_md`, `_lg` 3.9.8 and `la_core_web_trf` 3.9.9, already on Hugging Face.

- `pip install latincy` installs `la_core_web_sm`; extras `[md]`, `[lg]`, `[trf]` add the other sizes. Each model is also its own PyPI package: `la-core-web-sm`, `-md`, `-lg`, `-trf`, all 0.3.0. NB: The project is moving to LatinCy-specific versioning as opposed to previous SpaCy version alignment; the v3.9 SpaCy-type pipelines are not v0.3 LatinCy-type pipelines; full alignment is in progress and should be in place for v0.4.
- Model wheels stay on Hugging Face. Each `la-core-web-*` package is a source distribution whose build downloads the wheel from `huggingface.co/latincy/la_core_web_<size>` at a pinned commit, checks its sha256, and installs it; `spacy.load("la_core_web_<size>")` works as before.
- PyPI version is the LatinCy release (0.3.0); the model keeps its own version (`nlp.meta["version"]` 3.9.8 / 3.9.9). At install, 5 of the wheel's 37 files change: `.dist-info/METADATA` (version 0.3.0; project URLs `huggingface.co/latincy/la_core_web_<size>` and `github.com/latincy/latincy`; this package's README as description) and `RECORD`; the `url` value in both `meta.json` copies and the one Author link in the bundled model card `README.md`, each from the dead `github.com/diyclassics/latincy` to `huggingface.co/latincy/la_core_web_<size>`. Weights, vectors, code and all other bytes are identical to the HF wheel. The packages are source-only on PyPI, so `--only-binary :all:` installs cannot use them.
- `LATINCY_WHEELHOUSE=<dir>` installs from local copies of the wheels (offline / cluster); the sha256 is still checked.
- `latincy.load(size)` loads a pipeline by size; with no size it loads `sm` and emits `SmallModelWarning` with the install command for `lg` / `trf`.
- `python -m latincy` lists the four sizes, their versions and download sizes, and which are installed.
- Pins: `src/latincy/models.json` (model version, PyPI version, HF commit, sha256, bytes per size); `pyproject.toml` pins and the README model table must match it (tested).
